content.short: Tether's platform for tokenizing stocks, bonds, commodities, stablecoins and loyalty points.
content.description: Hadron, launched by Tether in November 2024, gives institutions, fund managers, governments and companies the tools to issue and manage tokenized assets, from equities and government bonds to commodities, stablecoins and reward points. It covers the full lifecycle of a token, with KYC, AML and risk controls built in, and supports several blockchains including Bitcoin layer 2s. Chainalysis is integrated for compliance.
content.meta: Hadron by Tether lets institutions tokenize stocks, bonds, commodities and stablecoins with compliance built in.
